sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The Custodian lets out a shrill cry. "The Keystone has finally responded! Surround me, the ritual must begin or I'll lose the pathway! Hurry!" Her glow swells, her eyes roll back, and the carriage lifts a foot off the ground. From the woods comes a chorus of unearthly screeches. The ground rumbles. Rusted swords break the surface as dead things claw their way up. In the distance, two shapes drift toward you, screeching, wrong. Hold the line until she's done.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Begin the defense and understand the countdown.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Start the ritual, show the first threats, and put the countdown die on the table.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Market Correction is available as a GM pressure valve, not player-facing terminology.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "d8, starting at 8. Defeat an enemy or remove a real pressure, it ticks down one. She gets hit or exposed, it ticks up one. At zero, the ritual is done and you win. The math is simple; staying alive is not."
